# KovaGPT

> KovaGPT is an AI workspace for conversational drafting, coding help, web-assisted answers, research, and image generation.

Signed-in Free users can select Default or Thinking. Thinking explicitly selects the next reasoning level. Plus includes Default, Medium, Thinking, and High. Pro additionally includes Extra High, Max, and Ultra. Model availability and usage limits are enforced by the server. Product labels do not imply separately trained model weights. Older Kova model names may still appear in existing conversations. Voice input is not currently part of the supported web product. Search, research, connected apps, and image generation depend on configured providers and account access. Scheduled background work and image editing are not currently available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Chat with KovaGPT, choose an available response mode, and attach supported files.
- [Images](/images): Generate images when an image provider is configured.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Compare Free, Plus, and Pro plans.
- [Apps](/apps): Review the connections currently available to your account.
